position: Reviewer roles are explicit, identity is still unverified
headline: The product can discuss capabilities honestly before selecting an authentication provider.
copy: Every simulator result says identity_verified false and production_allowed false, even when a bounded preview action is available.

postures.title: Observer
postures.copy: Can inspect source and rights evidence.

postures.title: Source reviewer
postures.copy: Can route and mark source evidence ready.

postures.title: Rights reviewer
postures.copy: Can route and mark rights evidence ready.

postures.title: Production permission
postures.copy: No role can publish, deploy, or launch.

flow.title: Request
flow.copy: Choose one bounded or forbidden operation.

flow.title: Evaluate
flow.copy: See the exact preview decision and denial reason.

flow.title: Defer
flow.copy: Add real identity proof, sessions, revocation, and audit before production.

decisions.label: Authentication
decisions.reason: The role label is not a verified person.

decisions.label: Preview policy
decisions.reason: Capability rules are deterministic and tested.

decisions.label: Next
decisions.reason: Use the policy only in a session-local operations preview.

locks.title: Deployment lock
locks.copy: No provider endpoint, domain, secret, or production runtime is activated.

locks.title: Write lock
locks.copy: No source, rights, reviewer, or learner write route exists.

locks.title: Identity lock
locks.copy: Role simulations do not authenticate a person or grant production access.

locks.title: Rights lock
locks.copy: Evidence-ready candidates remain blocked from publication and registry merge.

locks.title: Launch lock
locks.copy: Pilot readiness evidence cannot activate an invitation or public service.
